title: Code Ninjas Arlington Summer Camp Reminder - Week of August 24
description:
Hi Code Ninjas Campers,
We're excited to welcome your Ninja to Summer Camp at Code Ninjas Arlington! Get ready for an awesome week filled with STEAM activities, creativity, hands-on learning, and plenty of fun!
Here are a few important reminders to help you prepare for a great week. We provide all computers, technology, equipment, and materials needed for camp, so your Ninja does not need to bring a laptop or any special supplies from home.
Camp Location-
Code Ninjas Arlington
2499 North Harrison Street, LL-3
Arlington, VA 22207
Full-Day Camp Schedule — Monday–Friday

  *   Doors Open: 8:00 AM
  *   Drop-Off: Anytime between 8:00–9:00 AM
  *   Camp Activities Begin: 9:00 AM
  *   Lunch: 12:00–12:30 PM
  *
Afternoon Camp Activities: 12:30–3:30 PM
  *   Pick-Up: 4:00 PM

*Parents may drop off their Ninja anytime between 8:00 and 9:00 AM. Please plan to pick up your Ninja promptly at 4:00 PM.
 Please Bring Each Day -

  *   Nut-free lunch
  *   Nut-free snacks
  *   Refillable water bottle

Please make sure all food brought to camp is nut-free.
Our Senseis can't wait to meet your Ninja and help them create, explore, problem-solve, and build something amazing!
See you soon!
The Code Ninjas Arlington Team
📞 (703) 424-9134
📍 2499 North Harrison Street, LL-3, Arlington, VA 22207
🥷 More than a coding school, we’re a community where the next generation discovers their passions, develops future-ready skills, and gains the confidence to build what’s next.
